document.title: Publish PR reviews to GitHub Pages
document.summary: `scripts/pages-review.ts` pushes a static export to `gh-pages` at `pr/<n>/`. A workflow deletes that folder on PR close and after 30 days. The skill, AGENTS.md, and README tell agents to use it, and the VibeDrop skill is gone.
document.why: The [Cursor session](source:s1) asked to drop VibeDrop, publish reviews on GitHub Pages, and remove old reports when a PR closes or after a TTL. [PR #67](source:s2) records that same setup.

sources.label: Cursor session · Sep 12
sources.gist: Switch PR reports from VibeDrop to GitHub Pages. Remove VibeDrop references. Orphan old reports when a PR closes or after a TTL.

sources.label: PR #67
sources.title: Publish PR reviews to GitHub Pages
sources.gist: Export stays a static site. This repo publishes it to GitHub Pages at pr/<n>/. Pages must be enabled once. Close and a 30-day TTL remove old reviews.

sources.label: 16565de
sources.gist: Commit message names GitHub Pages at pr/<n>/, close cleanup, and a 30-day TTL.

lookFor: [PR #67](source:s2) says Pages is not on yet. No hunk calls the GitHub Pages API, so the published URL 404s until Settings uses branch `gh-pages`.
The [session](source:s1) asked for orphaning on close or a TTL. The workflow does both: closed PRs run `--pr`, and a daily cron runs `--ttl-days 30`.

groups.title: pages-review publish and prune
groups.why: Later groups call this script. [The session](source:s1) asked for GitHub Pages, not a new host.
groups.summary: `scripts/pages-review.ts` copies an export to `pr/<n>/` on `gh-pages`, writes `.nojekyll` and an index, and deletes folders by PR number or `published.json` age.
lookFor: Two publishes at once rebase and retry five times. A sixth conflict still fails the push.
A missing `published.json` is treated as 1970-01-01, so TTL prune deletes that folder.

groups.title: pages-review tests
groups.why: The publish script is new git worktree code. Tests pin publish, sibling folders, close prune, and TTL.
groups.summary: `scripts/pages-review.test.ts` drives a local bare remote through publish and prune. `package.json` includes `scripts/**/*.test.ts` in `pnpm test`.

groups.title: Pages prune workflow
groups.why: [The session](source:s1) asked to orphan reports when a PR closes or after a TTL.
groups.summary: `.github/workflows/pages-reviews.yml` runs `pages-review.ts prune --pr` on close, and `prune --ttl-days 30` on a daily cron.
lookFor: The daily job does not ask GitHub whether the PR is still open. An open PR older than 30 days loses its review unless someone republishes.

groups.title: Agent and README instructions
groups.why: Agents used VibeDrop because AGENTS.md said so. The skill and README have to name Pages instead.
groups.summary: AGENTS.md, README, and both skill copies tell agents to run `pages-review.ts publish` and to put the GitHub Pages URL in the PR body.
lookFor: The skill tells any GitHub repo to publish to `gh-pages` at `pr/<n>/`. Only this checkout has `scripts/pages-review.ts`. Other repos get the URL shape and no script.

groups.title: Remove the VibeDrop skill
groups.why: [The session](source:s1) asked to remove VibeDrop references. This file was the remaining copy.

commits.subject: Publish PR reviews to GitHub Pages instead of VibeDrop
commits.author: Cursor Agent
commits.body:
Export still writes a static site. This repo now pushes it to gh-pages at pr/<n>/. A workflow removes the folder when the PR closes, and drops reviews older than 30 days.

Co-authored-by: Máté Molnár <matemolnar8@users.noreply.github.com>
